b2_narrative: The Industrial-High-Tech tier concentrates in {econRegionStr} — Costa Rican provincias where Intel + Boston Scientific medical-device fab + Coyol Free Trade Zone depend on uninterrupted 138 kV transmission. With CR's ~99% renewable generation mix anchored on hydro (Reventazón + Arenal-Corobicí + Cachí + Pirrís) and El Niño hydro-deficit exposure (2024 was worst El Niño in 50 years — ICE imported via SIEPAC), {totalHCHR} High-Consequence High-Risk substations cluster in the central valley industrial belt. Top-tier R3 lower bound {topLower} reflects fab-corridor VoLL. Average fleet energy-poverty rate {avgEP}% (ARESEP 2024).
